description: This file defines JSON serialization settings and custom converters for types used in Orleans Redis clustering. It includes configuration for the JsonSerializerSettings object and converter classes for IPAddress, IPEndPoint, and SiloAddress types.

classes.name: IPAddressConverter
classes.description: Converts IPAddress objects to and from JSON string representations.

classes.name: IPEndPointConverter
classes.description: Converts IPEndPoint objects to and from JSON objects with Address and Port properties.

classes.name: SiloAddressConverter
classes.description: Converts SiloAddress objects to and from JSON objects with a SiloAddress string property.

methods.name: JsonSettings.JsonSerializerSettings
methods.description: Provides configured JsonSerializerSettings with custom converters and specific serialization options.

methods.name: IPAddressConverter.CanConvert
methods.description: Checks if the given type is IPAddress.

methods.name: IPAddressConverter.WriteJson
methods.description: Serializes an IPAddress to JSON as its string representation.

methods.name: IPAddressConverter.ReadJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an IPAddress object.

methods.name: IPEndPointConverter.CanConvert
methods.description: Checks if the given type is IPEndPoint.

methods.name: IPEndPointConverter.WriteJson
methods.description: Serializes an IPEndPoint into a JSON object with Address and Port.

methods.name: IPEndPointConverter.ReadJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into an IPEndPoint.

methods.name: SiloAddressConverter.CanConvert
methods.description: Checks if the given type is SiloAddress.

methods.name: SiloAddressConverter.WriteJson
methods.description: Serializes a SiloAddress to a JSON object with a SiloAddress string.

methods.name: SiloAddressConverter.ReadJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into a SiloAddress.
